Type: shelf
Name: Pinzon Jonesport Solid Oak and Glass Shelf
Colors: Kona
Beautiful modern hardwood and glass shelf offers great storage and display spaces Solid oak frame with 8mm glass shelves; holds up to 30 pounds per shelf Open front and sides for easy accessibility; arrives ready to assemble Coordinates with the Pinzon Jonesport Office Furniture Collection; kona brown finish Measures 28 inches wide by 16-1/2 inches deep by 65-1/4 inches high
